'''2025 Online Retro Event for Charity''' was a Players Committee Premiere-to-Virtual Set 3 event on GEMP. The published Top 8 starts with [[Joe Horbey]].<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-06-online-retro-event-for-charity-premiere-to-virtual-set-3/</ref> [[Andy Talaga]] announced the event and arranged its prizes, which included a Darksaber box, PC XL deckboxes, PC sleeves and exclusive alternate-image foils. Entry was a suggested $5 donation to a children's leukemia charity, made in honor of Shawn Valdez.<ref name="dc-1367923865745096794">"We will be donating to Children's Leukemia Research again in honor of Shawn Valdez.", andytalaga in #swccg-general, Retro Club Discord (2 May 2025). [https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/809922418096996367/1367923865745096794 Discord message]</ref>
